links.comparator_used: No system prompt (same LLMs: gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, llama-3.3-70b)
links.outcome: Proportion of dental questions with harmful LLM answers (at least one of five answers labeled harmful by at least one annotator, pooling Polish and English)
links.effect: Harmful rate 56% without a system prompt vs 30% with a safety-oriented system prompt (26 percentage point reduction)
links.quote: A safety-oriented system prompt reduced this rate by 26 percentage points to 30%.
